title: Claude ab bank account dekh kar paise ka hisaab dega #shorts
description:
AI news: Anthropic ne Claude me Personal Finance (beta) launch kiya. Bank/card accounts connect karo (Plaid se, read-only), phir apni bhasha me poochho paise kahan gaye. Is hafte se rollout, abhi sirf US ke Pro, Max aur Ultra plans par. Investment advice ke liye nahi hai; bade figures bank se check karo.

Source (official):
https://claude.com/resources/articles/introducing-personal-finance-in-claude

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: screenshots are our own capture of the official page (key lines highlighted). Synthetic voice.
